data.name: Jitender
data.gender_notes: Jitender is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jitender is derived from Sanskrit words 'jita' meaning victory and 'indra' meaning ruler or king. This name is given to a boy who is expected to lead and conquer in all walks of life. The name Jitender carries the meaning “Victorious, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jitender usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner warrior and the courage to overcome challenges and obstacles in life.
data.etymology: Jitender belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jitender total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
